verdict.rationale: Snyk Code is a SAST engine that shows the path of an issue from source to sink as a step-by-step flow, which is taint-style dataflow analysis. DeepCode AI also lets users write custom queries against code. However, no evidence explicitly says this tracking crosses file or function boundaries. missing for 10: explicit documentation of interprocedural/cross-file taint tracking, details on custom taint source/sink/sanitizer rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-file detection.
